Prevention: Rice field sanitation (plough up and over and solar sanitary) to destroy the pathogen.
Remove from the paddy and on the bunds to reduce the chance of infection and a reservoir of pathogenic fungi.
Seeding rate or plant spacing, direct seeding use sowing rate of 15-20 kg/rai and should avoid close spacing of plants density.
Apply a low amount of nitrogen fertilizer, use rate of nitrogen of (46-0-0) not over 10 kg/rai
If you need to apply fertilizer, split fertilizer applications into 2, instead of applying all at 1 time.
Monitoring: In epidemic areas, should random survey every 5 to 7 days. (if lesion symptom 1/3 of the height of the plant incidence/area need to control).
Monitor relative humidity and temperature, because the outbreak of disease can occur quickly.
Conditions such as temperature (28-32 ºC), humidity (RH 85-100 %) favours disease.
Therefore, the disease is more common during the rainy than in the dry season.
Direct Control: Sanitation, specifically removing weeds, can help control sheath blight.
Trichoderma harzianum , bacterial antagonists, such as
Bacillus subtilis (spraying during the outbreak initiation).
Restrictions: Apply when the outbreak of lesion symptoms is on 1/3 of the height of the plant incidence in the rice field.
